name: Gerbera

placement_rationale.text: 18 km is Gerbera's launch depth, not the 300–600 km range its own characteristics report for the decoy configuration — that range describes how far the airframe can fly toward a Ukrainian target, not how far back the launch crew sits. It shares its exact placement with Shahed-136/Geran-2 (also 18 km), matching this asset's own employment_notes that it is 'deliberately flown in mixed swarms alongside Shahed/Geran-2' — the two are launched from the same forward corridor precisely so defenders can't distinguish them before impact. 18 km sits inside doctrine.md §2's drone-dense corridor (~30 km either side of the front), plausible for a mobile launch/staging position closer to the border or contact line than Russia's deep interior. (Nudged 18→17.6 km from this category's shared round-number value so it doesn't literally coincide with side_b-uav-shahed-136-geran-2 on the map's distance axis — a small, deterministic spread within the same band, not a new plausibility claim beyond what's already argued above.)

sources.label: Militarnyi — Russians significantly modernized Shahed and Gerbera drones

cost.display: ~$10,000 (Wikipedia); $5,000-100,000 range cited in user-supplied catalog depending on configuration

characteristics: Strength: Cheap enough to be expended purely as a radar/interceptor decoy, saturating air defense attention and ammunition even when unarmed
Limitation: As an armed variant its warhead is small (<7kg) compared to Shahed-136/Geran-2's 50-90kg
Estimated quantity available: Mass produced; exact fleet size not disclosed
employment_notes: Deliberately flown in mixed swarms alongside Shahed/Geran-2 and Italmas drones so defenders cannot easily distinguish real threats from decoys - a direct, deliberate exploitation of the cost-asymmetry dynamic
contrast_vs_traditional: Gerbera is explicitly built to be mistaken for a Shahed on radar and burn through interceptor stocks meant for the real thing — a decoy doing traditional electronic-warfare deception's job with cheap airframes instead of jamming, which is as much a part of the EW-dependent picture doctrine.md describes as any radio-frequency system on this map.

notes: Specs meet the bar but the unit cost is an estimate — cost is not verified.

altitude_band_m.note: Flown as a Shahed-class decoy/strike airframe, so the Geran-2 envelope is the closest defensible band. Not a published figure for this airframe.
